name: Mirrored Voice
description: Mirror an ally's soul voice with the user's so both sound as one and the ally's work gains clarity.

name: Pairing Tone
description: Sound a pairing tone and learn from the answer which ally's soul sits closest to the user's own.

name: Duet Ward
description: Sing a duet ward round two souls so that a hostile tone strikes both lightly and neither deeply.

name: Duet Swell
description: Swell the user's line and a partner's together so their combined soul work gains weight beat by beat.

name: Harmony Wash
description: Wash a partner's soul in a clean harmony until the hostile tone clinging to it falls away.

name: Echo Mending
description: Echo a partner's whole soul tone back to them from the user's own until the tears in it close.

name: Twin Resonance
description: Set two souls to ring each other in perfect sympathy so each technique of both runs at full strength.

name: Duet Rekindle
description: Sing a full duet over a partner whose soul has gone dark and rekindle it within the short window.

name: Grand Duet
description: Weave the voices of the user and a partner into a grand duet that lifts both souls to the limit of their rung.

name: Track Count
description: Count the tracks running in a chorus to learn which voices carry the work and which carry the strength.

name: Track Lend
description: Lend one track of the user's soul tone to an ally whose own track has thinned.

name: Track Guard
description: Hold one track as a guard and one as a blade so a hostile tone meets the guard first.

name: Track Mend
description: Run the second track through an ally's wounded soul to knit the gaps their own track has lost.

name: Parallel Swell
description: Swell two parallel tracks at once so the work of the company and its strength rise together.

name: Parallel Rinse
description: Rinse a hostile stain from an ally's soul along the second track while the first keeps its work.

name: Crossed Track
description: Cross a foe's two tracks of soul work so that one cancels the other and the technique fails.

name: Antiphonal Surge
description: Surge both tracks of the chorus together until every soul in it works above its usual measure.

name: Shatter Chorus
description: Send a shattering chorus through a rank of foes so their joined soul work splits and falls silent.

name: Dual Crown
description: Crown an allied company with twin tracks of tone that raise each soul to its fullest and hold it there.

name: Crown Hum
description: Hum a high crowning note over an ally so their soul technique climbs and does not flag.

name: Crown Sight
description: Look down from a high clear note and see the whole company's soul tones laid out below.

name: Plume Screen
description: Spread a plume of light tone over the user that turns a hostile soul stroke aside.

name: Soaring Mend
description: Raise the pitch of an ally's worn soul step by step until it soars clear of its strain.

name: Talon Pitch
description: Close a talon of sharp pitch on an opponent's soul and tear a thread of their focus away.

name: Crowned Swell
description: Swell a crowning note over the company so each ally's soul technique rises on the same bright line.

name: Clear Plume
description: Brush a clear plume of tone down an ally's soul to sweep away a clinging hostile taint.

name: Soaring Sequence
description: Chain the soul strikes of three allies on one rising line so each blow lands higher than the last.

name: Hawk Harmony
description: Spread a hawk's wide harmony over the company so every ally sees clearly and acts as one.

name: Plunging Tone
description: Drop a single plunging tone from a great height that pierces every ward around an opponent's soul.

name: Crown Ascendant
description: Crown the whole company with a harmony that climbs without end and keeps every soul working at its height.

name: Second Voice
description: Add a second voice beneath an ally's soul tone so that it stands firmer and rings fuller.

name: Pair Harken
description: Listen for the answering voice of a paired partner across a crowd of mixed souls.

name: Mirror Guard
description: Hold up a mirror of tone that gives a hostile soul note back as a dull and harmless sound.

name: Second Swell
description: Swell the second voice under a partner's technique until it answers the first in perfect time.

name: Twin Purge
description: Purge a curse of discord from a partner's soul with a pair of cleansing notes struck together.

name: Echoed Stroke
description: Follow a partner's soul stroke with its exact echo so that the foe feels the blow twice.

name: Twin Chorale
description: Sound a slow chorale for two voices that lifts both souls and steadies every technique they hold.

name: Pair Rekindle
description: Call the soul of a fallen partner back with its own paired note within the short window.

name: Twin Sovereign Chord
description: Strike a sovereign chord for two souls at once so that both work as one will with doubled depth.

name: Sworn Hum
description: Hum the sworn note of the chorus beside an ally so their soul holds firm to the oath.

name: Wind Listen
description: Let the wind bring back the tones of the souls around the user and mark each one by its sound.

name: Gale Veil
description: Draw a veil of rushing tone round the user that scatters a hostile soul note like dust.

name: Sworn Mending
description: Sing the sworn mending over an ally until the frayed edges of their soul draw together.

name: Wind Rap
description: Rap a hard gust of tone against an opponent's soul so that it rings and numbs their reply.

name: Wind Choir
description: Raise a choir on the wind so that each ally's soul work is carried on one long breath.

name: Gale Wash
description: Sweep a clean gale of tone through an ally's soul and carry the hostile taint away with it.

name: Roaring Chorus
description: Roar a chorus of jarring tones at a foe so that their soul technique shakes loose from its form.

name: Rolling Refrain
description: Roll the refrain from ally to ally so that each soul strike builds on the one before.

name: Wind-Sworn Surge
description: Surge the sworn chorus across the whole company until every soul works at the strength of the oath.

name: Sworn Awakening
description: Sing the oath over a fallen comrade whose soul has gone still and wake it within the short window.

name: Great Oath Chorus
description: Raise the whole oath chorus in one vast voice that carries every soul in the company past its usual limit.

name: Refrain Mark
description: Mark the refrain on every ally's soul and learn which of them has begun to flag.

name: Refrain Lend
description: Lend the refrain to a wavering ally so their soul remembers the note it was sworn to hold.

name: Refrain Veil
description: Sing a quiet veil of refrain round the user to blunt a hostile tone as it arrives.

name: Refrain Balm
description: Sing the refrain low over an ally's soul like a balm until the ache in it quiets.

name: Rising Refrain
description: Raise the refrain a step at each repeat so the soul work of the company climbs with it.

name: Refrain Release
description: Sing the release verse of the refrain and loose a hostile bond from the soul of a comrade.

name: Broken Refrain
description: Break the repeating line of a foe's soul technique so it cannot gather its second beat.

name: Sworn Cascade
description: Let the sworn refrain cascade from soul to soul down the company so each ally takes on the strength of the one before.

name: Calling Refrain
description: Sing the calling verse over a comrade at the edge of death to draw their soul back before it goes.

name: Undying Refrain
description: Sing the refrain that cannot be silenced so the company's souls hold their work however the foe presses.

name: Compass Tone
description: Sound a compass tone and read where each soul stands in the chord of the company.

name: Course Lend
description: Lend a true course tone to an ally so their soul work does not drift from the chord.

name: Bearing Guard
description: Hold the bearing of the chord against a hostile tone that tries to pull the user off it.

name: Course Swell
description: Swell the true course of the chord so allies hold to it more firmly with each beat.

name: Bearing Wash
description: Wash a skewed tone out of an ally's soul and restore its true place in the chord.

name: Drift Tone
description: Sound a drifting tone that pulls the souls of foes away from their shared chord.

name: Harmonic Bearing
description: Fix the whole company to a single harmonic bearing so that no ally can be pulled from the chord.

name: Far Bearing
description: Send a long bearing tone out over the field and read every soul it touches at great range.

name: Sovereign Bearing
description: Take the bearing of the whole company into the user's own note and hold every soul to its place.

name: Open Voice
description: Let the soul voice ring out openly beside an ally so their technique draws from its full sound.

name: Open Hearing
description: Open the soul's hearing to its widest and catch the tone of every soul on the field.

name: Open Ward
description: Stand in the open and let a ward of tone rise from the voice alone against hostile soul force.

name: Open Balm
description: Pour the open voice over a worn ally like a balm until their soul recovers its depth.

name: Open Cry
description: Cry out in the open voice so that the sound lands in an opponent's soul as a hard blow.

name: Open Chorus
description: Swell an open chorus from every ally in earshot so their combined soul work grows with each voice.

name: Open Purging
description: Cleanse a comrade's soul in the open voice so every hidden stain is sung into the light.

name: Calling Voice
description: Call a scattered company back to one voice so its souls regain their joined strength.

name: Open Sequence
description: Let each ally's soul strike fall on the open beat in turn so the foe cannot find a gap.

name: Voice Without Limit
description: Raise the open voice past every usual limit until the whole company works with unbounded clarity.

name: Unbarred Rekindle
description: Sing the barred soul of a fallen comrade open again within the short window before it fades.

name: Limitless Reach
description: Let the open voice carry to the farthest edge of the field and return the soul tone of all upon it.

name: Unwalled Concord
description: Raise a concord that stands unwalled in the open and still carries every soul in it past its limit.
